name: Etched Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Etched Rune calls promising dwarven hunters to Anvilmar. Hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson sends it to begin their instruction in the wilderness.

sections.title: Call of the Wild
sections.body: Dwarven runes mark the Etched Rune, sent to novices who show promise in Coldridge Valley’s snowdrifts. Mountaineer and hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson calls fledgling trackers to Anvilmar. There, they move beyond basic survival and learn the hunter’s craft: respect for Dun Morogh’s beasts, tracking mountain predators, care for ranged weapons, and endurance in the harsh elements.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Rune?
aliases: why do i have etched rune
faq.answer: The Etched Rune calls aspiring dwarven hunters to seek Thorgas Grimson inside Anvilmar for formal guidance in the hunter’s craft.

faq.q: Who wrote or sent the Etched Rune?
faq.answer: Thorgas Grimson, the hunter trainer in Anvilmar, sends the rune to novice outdoorsmen in Coldridge Valley who show a knack for surviving the frozen wilderness.

faq.q: Where do I take the Etched Rune once I have read it?
aliases: where do i bring etched rune
faq.answer: Take the Etched Rune to Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Thorgas Grimson waits near the forge and training halls to teach you tracking, weapon care, and dwarven hunting traditions.

angles.text: As a hunter, the rune calls you into the craft of dwarven hunting. You learn to track, respect your animal companions, and survive the wilderness through your own wits.
As a dwarf, you know carved stones and runes carry trade knowledge and urgent instructions through Coldridge Valley’s snows.
